# Service Catalogue

## [Consultancy Name] — Data, Automation & AI Advisory

### *Microsoft 365–centric. Ecosystem-agnostic where it matters.*

---

## Our Positioning

We help organisations unlock the full value of their data, automate the work that doesn't need humans, and deploy artificial intelligence responsibly — with Microsoft 365 as the primary operating platform and a pragmatic, best-of-breed approach everywhere else. We are not a Microsoft reseller. We are your independent thinking partner.

---

## 1. DATA

### 1.1 Data Audits & Discovery

| Service | Description |
|---|---|
| **M365 Data Footprint Audit** | Full inventory of data across SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, Exchange, Viva, and legacy on-prem stores. Classify by sensitivity, ownership, retention status, and regulatory exposure. |
| **Data Lineage & Flow Mapping** | Trace how data moves between systems — M365, Azure, SaaS applications, on-prem databases, and third-party tools. Identify shadow IT, orphaned datasets, and unmanaged copies. |
| **Data
